key_findings: Cav3.2 intrinsically disordered region peptides iPA1 and iPA2 inhibit Cav3.2 current by about 70% and 60% without changing gating or Nav1.7 current.
AAV6-mediated DRG expression of iPA1/iPA2 reversed established evoked and spontaneous neuropathic pain and normalized neuronal hyperexcitability in rats of both sexes.
